What it does

An AI booking and scheduling agent lets your clients book, reschedule, and cancel appointments through a simple conversation on your site, chat, or WhatsApp. It checks real availability, writes the appointment straight to your calendar, and sends reminders automatically to cut down no-shows.

It's ideal for any appointment-driven business — clinics, salons, agencies, consultants, and home services — where staff lose hours to scheduling back-and-forth and revenue leaks through missed slots and no-shows.

FAQ

Common questions

What is an AI booking and scheduling agent?

It's an AI software agent that lets clients book, reschedule, and cancel appointments in a natural conversation. It checks your real availability, writes bookings to your calendar, and sends automatic reminders to reduce no-shows — 24/7.

Does it sync with my calendar?

Yes. We connect it to Google Calendar or your scheduling tool so every booking, reschedule, and cancellation updates in real time. It only ever offers slots you're actually available for.

How does it reduce no-shows?

It automatically sends confirmation and reminder messages before each appointment, and can follow up on missed appointments to rebook them — so fewer slots go to waste.

Can clients book without filling out a form?

Yes. Instead of forms or phone tag, clients just chat — on your website, live chat, or WhatsApp — and the agent handles the rest, including picking the right service and staff member.

How long does it take to go live?

Most booking agents are live within days. After a short discovery call, we build, integrate, and deploy it for you — nothing to install on your side.

Do I need to manage AI accounts or API keys?

No. We manage all model access and API costs on our infrastructure. You get a working agent connected to your calendar — no DevOps and no usage bills.

Ready for your own booking & scheduling agent?

Tell us what you want to automate and we'll show you exactly what your booking agent can do — built, hosted, and managed for you.
